content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Matt Plessner <mmplessner@gmail.com>
Sent: Sunday, April 19, 2020 10:45 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: MLB The Show 
 
Anthony,

I am really enjoying the Virtual Tigers, thanks for doing it.  I enjoy watching the games but what is really enjoyable is your commentary and the comments from all the other loyal followers.  Work is really slow for me now so I am usually home near 'gametime'.
I used to play The Show when I had a PS3 but now have an XBox so I can't play it.
I included a link that you can check out, has lots of great info on the game from a lot of people who know a lot about the game.

One thing you might be interested in is the "Historical Rosters" that some people make and they are downloadable.  Not sure exactly what teams are available but I am sure you can find some great Detroit teams from the past.  Might be a fun way to pass some time while on furlough.
